# bin by P, look at spread in dP at fixed P
bins=np.linspace(0.3,6,12)
for i in range(len(bins)-1):
    m=(P>=bins[i])&(P<bins[i+1])
    if m.sum()>3:
        print(round(bins[i],2), m.sum(), np.round(np.mean(dP_dt[m]),3), np.round(np.std(dP_dt[m]),3), np.round(np.corrcoef(t[m],dP_dt[m])[0,1],2))
# fit f(P) via polynomial in P and look at residual vs t

r=dP_dt-np.polyval(c,P)
print('resid std',r.std())
for i in range(0,12):
